requests_per_million: Actual common-credit submissions *1e6 / actual retired instructions; current-line rejected before credit; duplicates counted separately, not deduplicated
coverage: LOAD-only timely cohort usefulness / same-ROI NoPF LOAD misses; SPP is only tracked L2-target subset, never all-SPP coverage
accuracy: LOAD usefulness / fully tracked L2-target PQ-enqueued cohort. Pending/resident-unused remain right-censored in this denominator. Resolved-only accuracy conditions on observed resolution. LLC-only accuracy/timeliness null; old mixed-fill SPP cohorts unavailable.
submission_yield: l2_target_tracked_load_uses_per_submission = tracked L2-target LOAD uses / L2-target allowed cache calls. This is not complete-cohort accuracy: submitted calls include merge/reject and possible WQ-forward outcomes. Historical request_cache_enqueued means API accepted-nonmerged (-1), while request_cache_pq_inserted is actual PQ insertion.
timeliness: L2-target timely LOAD / (timely+late LOAD); LLC-only usefulness unavailable
dram: Instrumented completed controller bus transactions*line size; initial/end queues and bus-start/in-progress separate. No issued*64 inference.
filter_pairs: Same seed/ROI/cost/common cap and frozen checkpoint; current filter changes only the common output gate before credit. Cache feedback can change later arrivals, generated outputs and completions, so equal generated counts or equal realized requests are not assumed. Classified current-line allowed count must be zero in filtered arms; both cap arms independently obey the validation-selected ceiling.
distributions: All completed ROI events accumulated in disjoint5M instruction phases, last phase absorbs retirement overshoot. Full ROI is their exact sum. Raw learned forward outputs and final replacement payload distributions are separate. Generation/allowed/useful cohort-phase definitions in measurement schema.
classified_requests: Engine mechanism_request_profile counts generated payload addresses before engine output filters. Observer mechanism_classified_requests ARRAY counts actual cache-call attempts after those filters. classified_requests.csv preserves every group and nested L2 cohort; LLC-only L2 outcomes null, native SPP slot/duplicate/teacher unknown (-1). Origin phase is payload generation/completion, not input arrival. actual_attempt/allowed_phase_counts record actual gate phases separately. Redundant/timely/late/useful/censored lifecycles are credited to the originating generation phase. The older100k cohort buckets are instead actual PQ-enqueue instruction buckets. Compatible old Stride references have no new classified profiles; they are not imputed.
startup: Every saved cumulative snapshot plus exact adjacent interval IPC; prefixes are not whole-ROI distributions or minimum observation thresholds.
pc_gate: Frozen exact-PC bounded64 table fitted to full train+validation NN emit outputs, majority fixed>=0.5, top-frequency fixed selection, unseen PC silent; no test fitting. A gap is not evidence of stateful novelty.
cost: NN-gate replacement keeps full original forward and h/c; zero-cost arms are functional comparators. MAC4 is only seed7 cost reference. Table/CAM/add latency and physical energy/PPA are not synthesized.
